title: syncalathium kawaguchii
intro: Syncalathium kawaguchii, commonly known as Japanese mountain mint, is a flowering plant in the mint family. It is used in traditional medicine, particularly in Japan, where it is valued for its potential health benefits, including the alleviation of fever, colds, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Syncalathium kawaguchii include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
